verses.36: Σύντριψον τὸν βραχίονα τοῦ ἁμαρτωλοῦ καὶ πονηροῦ, ζητηθήσεται ἡ ἁμαρτία αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐ μὴ εὑρεθῇ.
verses.37: Βασιλεύσει Κύριος εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος, ἀπολεῖσθε ἔθνη ἐκ τῆς γῆς αὐτοῦ.
verses.38: Τὴν ἐπιθυμίαν τῶν πενήτων εἰσήκουσε Κύριος, τὴν ἑτοιμασίαν τῆς καρδίας αὐτῶν προσέσχε τὸ οὖς σου·
verses.39: Κρῖναι ὀρφανῷ καὶ ταπεινῷ, ἵνα μὴ προσθῇ ἔτι μεγαλαυχεῖν ἄνθρωπος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

verses.1: For the end, a Psalm of David, concerning the secrets of the Son.
verses.2: I will give thanks to thee, O Lord, with my whole heart; I will recount all thy wonderful works.
verses.3: I will be glad and exult in thee: I will sing to thy name, O thou Most High.
verses.4: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall be feeble and perish at thy presence.
verses.5: For thou hast maintained my cause and my right; thou satest on the throne, that judgest righteousness.
verses.6: Thou hast rebuked the nations, and the ungodly one has perished; thou hast blotted out their name for ever, even for ever and ever.
verses.7: The swords of the enemy have failed utterly; and thou hast destroyed cities: their memorial has been destroyed with a noise,
verses.8: but the Lord endures for ever: he has prepared his throne for judgment.
verses.9: And he will judge the world in righteousness, he will judge the nations in uprightness.
verses.10: The Lord also is become a refuge for the poor, a seasonable help, in affliction.
verses.11: And let them that know thy name hope in thee: for thou, O Lord, hast not failed them that diligently seek thee.
verses.12: Sing praises to the Lord, who dwells in Sion: declare his dealings among the nations.
verses.13: For he remembered them, in making inquisition for blood: he has not forgotten the supplication of the poor.
verses.14: Have mercy upon me, O Lord; look upon my affliction which I suffer of mine enemies, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:
verses.15: that I may declare all thy praises in the gates of the daughter of Sion: I will exult in thy salvation.
verses.16: The heathen are caught in the destruction which they planned: in the very snare which they hid is their foot taken.
verses.17: The Lord is known as executing judgments: the sinner is taken in the works of his hands. A song of Pause.
verses.18: Let sinners be driven away into Hades, even all the nations that forget God.
verses.19: For the poor shall not be forgotten for ever: the patience of the needy ones shall not perish for ever.
verses.20: Arise, O Lord, let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged before thee.
verses.21: Appoint, O Lord, a lawgiver over them: let the heathen know that they are men. Pause.
verses.22: Why standest thou afar off, O Lord? why dost thou overlook us in times of need, in affliction?
verses.23: While the ungodly one acts proudly, the poor is hotly pursued: the wicked are taken in the crafty counsels which they imagine.
verses.24: Because the sinner praises himself for the desires of his heart; and the unjust one blesses himself.
verses.25: The sinner has provoked the Lord: according to the abundance of his pride he will not seek after him: God is not before him.
verses.26: His ways are profane at all times; thy judgments are removed from before him: he will gain the mastery over all his enemies.
verses.27: For he has said in his heart, I shall not be moved, continuing without evil from generation to generation.
verses.28: Whose mouth is full of cursing, and bitterness, and fraud: under his tongue are trouble and pain.
verses.29: He lies in wait with rich men in secret places, in order to slay the innocent: his eyes are set against the poor.
verses.30: He lies in wait in secret as a lion in his den: he lies in wait to ravish the poor, to ravish the poor when he draws him after him: he will bring him down in his snare.
verses.31: He will bow down and fall when he has mastered the poor.
verses.32: For he has said in his heart, God has forgotten: he has turned away his face so as never to look.
verses.33: Arise, O Lord God; let thy hand be lifted up: forget not the poor.

verses.1: A Prayer of David. Hearken, O Lord of my righteousness, attend to my petition; give ear to my prayer not uttered with deceitful lips.
verses.2: Let my judgment come forth from thy presence; let mine eyes behold righteousness.
verses.3: Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited me by night; thou hast tried me as with fire, and unrighteousness has not been found in me: I am purposed that my mouth shall not speak amiss.
verses.4: As for the works of men, by the words of thy lips I have guarded myself from hard ways.
verses.5: Direct my steps in thy paths, that my steps slip not.
verses.6: I have cried, for thou heardest me, O God: incline thine ear to me, and hearken to my words.
verses.7: Shew the marvels of thy mercies, thou that savest them that hope in thee.
verses.8: Keep me as the apple of the eye from those that resist thy right hand: thou shalt screen me by the covering of thy wings,
verses.9: from the face of the ungodly that have afflicted me: mine enemies have compassed about my soul.
verses.10: They have enclosed themselves with their own fat: their mouth has spoken pride.
verses.11: They have now cast me out and compassed me round about: they have set their eyes so as to bow them down to the ground.
verses.12: They laid wait for me as a lion ready for prey, and like a lion's whelp dwelling in secret places.
verses.13: Arise, O Lord, prevent them, and cast them down: deliver my soul from the ungodly: draw thy sword,
verses.14: because of the enemies of thine hand: O Lord, destroy them from the earth; scatter them in their life, though their belly has been filled with thy hidden treasures: they have been satisfied with uncleanness, and have left the remnant of their possessions to their babes.
verses.15: But I shall appear in righteousness before thy face: I shall be satisfied when thy glory appears.

verses.1: I will love thee, O LORD, my strength.
verses.2: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
verses.3: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
verses.4: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.
verses.5: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.
verses.6: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.
verses.7: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.
verses.8: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
verses.9: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.
verses.10: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.
verses.11: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.
verses.12: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.
verses.13: The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.
verses.14: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.
verses.15: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.
verses.16: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.
verses.17: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.
verses.18: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.
verses.19: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.20: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
verses.21: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.22: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.
verses.23: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.
verses.24: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
verses.25: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;
verses.26: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.
verses.27: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.
verses.28: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.
verses.29: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.
verses.30: As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.
verses.31: For who is God save the LORD? or who is a rock save our God?
verses.32: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.
verses.33: He maketh my feet like hinds’ feet, and setteth me upon my high places.
verses.34: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
verses.35: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.
verses.36: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.
verses.37: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.
verses.38: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.
verses.39: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
verses.40: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.
verses.41: They cried, but there was none to save them: even unto the LORD, but he answered them not.
verses.42: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.
verses.43: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; and thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.
verses.44: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.
verses.45: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.
verses.46: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.
verses.47: It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.
verses.48: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
verses.49: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.
verses.50: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.

verses.14: Καὶ ἐβρόντησεν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ Κύριος, καὶ ὁ ὕψιστος ἔδωκε φωνὴν αὐτοῦ.
verses.15: Καὶ ἐξαπέστειλε βέλη καὶ ἐσκόρπισεν αὐτοὺς, καὶ ἀστραπὰς ἐπλήθυνε καὶ συνετάραξεν αὐτούς.
verses.16: Καὶ ὤφθησαν αἱ πηγαὶ τῶν ὑδάτων, καὶ ἀνεκαλύφθη τὰ θεμέλια τῆς οἰκουμένης· ἀπὸ ἐπιτιμήσεώς σου Κύριε, ἀπὸ ἐνπνεύσεως πνεύματος ὀργῆς σου.
verses.17: Ἐξαπέστειλεν ἐξ ὕψους καὶ ἔλαβέ με, προσελάβετό με ἐξ ὑδάτων πολλῶν.
verses.18: Ῥύσεταί με ἐξ ἐχθρῶν μου δυνατῶν, καὶ ἐκ τῶν μισούντων με, ὅτι ἐστερεώθησαν ὑπὲρ ἐμέ.
verses.19: Προέφθασάν με ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κακώσεώς μου, καὶ ἐγένετο Κύριος ἀντιστήριγμά μου.
verses.20: Καὶ ἐξήγαγέ με εἰς πλατυσμὸν, ῥύσεταί με, ὅτι ἠθέλησέ με.
verses.21: Καὶ ἀνταποδώσει μοι Κύριος κατὰ τὴν δικαιοσύνην μου, καὶ κατὰ τὴν καθαριότητα τῶν χειρῶν μου ἀνταποδώσει μοι.
verses.22: Ὅτι ἐφύλαξα τὰς ὁδοὺς Κυρίου, καὶ οὐκ ἠσέβησα ἀπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ μου.
verses.23: Ὅτι πάντα τὰ κρίματα αὐτοῦ ἐνώπιόν μου, καὶ τὰ δικαιώματα αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἀπέστησαν ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ.
verses.24: Καὶ ἔσομαι ἄμωμος μετʼ αὐτοῦ, καὶ φυλάξομαι ἀπὸ τῆς ἀνομίας μου.
verses.25: Καὶ ἀνταποδώσει μοι Κύριος κατὰ τὴν δικαιοσύνην μου, καὶ κατὰ τὴν καθαριότητα τῶν χειρῶν μου ἐνώπιον τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτοῦ.
verses.26: Μετὰ ὁσίου ὁσιωθήσῃ, καὶ μετὰ ἀνδρὸς ἀθώου ἀθῶος ἔσῃ·
verses.27: Καὶ μετὰ ἐκλεκτοῦ ἐκλεκτὸς ἔσῃ, καὶ μετὰ στρεβλοῦ διαστρέψεις.
verses.28: Ὅτι σὺ λαὸν ταπεινὸν σώσεις, καὶ ὀφθαλμοὺς ὑπερηφάνων ταπεινώσεις.
verses.29: Ὅτι σὺ φωτιεῖς λύχνον μου Κύριε, ὁ Θεός μου φωτιεῖς τὸ σκότος μου.
verses.30: Ὅτι ἐν σοὶ ῥυσθήσομαι ἀπὸ πειρατηρίου, καὶ ἐν τῷ Θεῷ μου ὑπερβήσομαι τεῖχος.
verses.31: Ὁ Θεός μου, ἄμωμος ἡ ὁδὸς αὐτοῦ, τὰ λόγια Κυρίου πεπυρωμένα, ὑπερασπιστής ἐστι πάντων τῶν ἐλπιζόντων ἐπʼ αὐτόν.
verses.32: Ὅτι τίς Θεὸς πλὴν τοῦ Κυρίου; καὶ τίς Θεὸς πλὴν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν;
verses.33: Ὁ Θεὸς ὁ περιζωννύων με δύναμιν, καὶ ἔθετο ἄμωμον τὴν ὁδόν μου·
verses.34: ὁ καταρτιζόμενος τοὺς πόδας μου ὡσεὶ ἐλάφου, καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ ὑψηλὰ ἱστῶν με·
verses.35: Διδάσκων χεῖράς μου εἰς πόλεμον· καὶ ἔθου τόξον χαλκοῦν τοὺς βραχίονάς μου,
verses.36: καὶ ἔδωκάς με ὑπερασπισμὸν σωτηρίας μου· καὶ ἡ δεξιά σου ἀντελάβετό μου, καὶ ἡ παιδεία σου ἀνώρθωσέ με εἰς τέλος, καὶ ἡ παιδεία σου αὐτή με διδάξει.
verses.37: Ἐπλάτυνας τὰ διαβήματά μου ὑποκάτω μου, καὶ οὐκ ἠσθένησαν τὰ ἴχνη μου.
verses.38: Καταδιώξω τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου, καὶ καταλήψομαι αὐτοὺς, καὶ οὐκ ἀποστραφήσομαι, ἕως ἂν ἐκλείπωσιν.
verses.39: Ἐκθλίψω αὐτοὺς, καὶ οὐ μὴ δύνωνται στῆναι, πεσοῦνται ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας μου.
verses.40: Καὶ περιέζωσάς με δύναμιν εἰς πόλεμον, συνεπόδισας πάντας τοὺς ἐπανισταένους ἐπʼ ἐμὲ ὑποκάτω μου.
verses.41: Καὶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου ἔδωκάς μοι νῶτον, καὶ τοὺς μισοῦντάς με ἐξωλόθρευσας.
verses.42: Ἐκέκραξαν, καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ σώζων· πρὸς Κύριον, καὶ οὐκ εἰσήκουεν αὐτῶν.
verses.43: Καὶ λεπτυνῶ αὐτοὺς ὡς χοῦν κατὰ πρόσωπον ἀνέμου, ὡς πηλὸν πλατειῶν λεανῶ αὐτούς.
verses.44: Ῥῦσαί με ἐξ ἀντιλογιῶν λαοῦ, καταστήσεις με εἰς κεφαλὴν ἐθνῶν· λαὸς ὃν οὐκ ἔγνων, ἐδούλευσέ μοι,
verses.45: εἰς ἀκοὴν ὠτίου ὑπήκουσέ μοι· υἱοὶ ἀλλότριοι ἐψεύσαντό μοι,
verses.46: υἱοὶ ἀλλότριοι ἐπαλαιώθησαν, καὶ ἐχώλαναν ἀπὸ τῶν τρίβων αὐτῶν.
verses.47: Ζῇ Κύριος, καὶ εὐλογητὸς ὁ Θεός μου, καὶ ὑψωθήτω ὁ Θεὸς τῆς σωτηρίας μου.
verses.48: Ὁ Θεὸς ὁ διδοὺς ἐκδικήσεις ἐμοὶ, καὶ ὑποτάξας λαοὺς ὑπʼ ἐμὲ,
verses.49: ὁ ῥύστης μου ἐξ ἐχθρῶν ὀργίλων· ἀπὸ τῶν ἐπανισταμένων ἐπʼ ἐμὲ ὑψώσεις με, ἀπὸ ἀνδρὸς ἀδίκου ῥύσῃ με.
verses.50: Διὰ τοῦτο ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι ἐν ἔθνεσι, Κύριε, καὶ τῷ ὀνόματί σου ψαλῶ.
verses.51: Μεγαλύνων τὰς σωτηρίας τοῦ βασιλέως αὐτοῦ, καὶ ποιῶν ἔλεος τῷ χριστῷ αὐτοῦ τῷ Δαυὶδ, καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ ἕως αἰῶνος.

verses.1: For the end, a Psalm of David the servant of the Lord; the words which he spoke to the Lord, even the words of this Song, in the day in which the Lord delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul: and he said:
verses.2: I will love thee, O Lord, my strength.
verses.3: The Lord is my firm support, and my refuge, and my deliverer; my God is my helper, I will hope in him; he is my defender, and the horn of my salvation, and my helper.
verses.4: I will call upon the Lord with praises, and I shall be saved from mine enemies.
verses.5: The pangs of death compassed me, and the torrents of ungodliness troubled me exceedingly.
verses.6: The pangs of hell came round about me: the snares of death prevented me.
verses.7: And when I was afflicted I called upon the Lord, and cried to my God: he heard my voice out of his holy temple, and my cry shall enter before him, even into his ears.
verses.8: Then the earth shook and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains were disturbed, and were shaken, because God was angry with them.
verses.9: There went up a smoke in his wrath, and fire burst into a flame at his presence: coals were kindled at it.
verses.10: And he bowed the heaven, and came down: and thick darkness was under his feet.
verses.11: And he mounted on cherubs and flew: he flew on the wings of winds.
verses.12: And he made darkness his secret place: round about him was his tabernacle, even dark water in the clouds of the air.
verses.13: At the brightness before him the clouds passed, hail and coals of fire.
verses.14: The Lord also thundered from heaven, and the Highest uttered his voice.
verses.15: And he sent forth his weapons, and scattered them; and multiplied lightnings, and routed them.
verses.16: And the springs of waters appeared, and the foundations of the world were exposed, at thy rebuke, O Lord, at the blasting of the breath of thy wrath.
verses.17: He sent from on high and took me, he drew me to himself out of many waters.
verses.18: He will deliver me from my mighty enemies, and from them that hate me; for they are stronger than I.
verses.19: They prevented me in the day of mine affliction: but the Lord was my stay against them.
verses.20: And he brought me out into a wide place: he will deliver me, because he has pleasure in me.
verses.21: And the Lord will recompense me according to my righteousness; even according to the purity of my hands will he recompense me.
verses.22: For I have kept the ways of the Lord and have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.23: For all his judgments were before me, and his ordinances departed not from me.
verses.24: And I shall be blameless with him, and shall keep myself from mine iniquity.
verses.25: And the Lord shall recompense me according to my righteousness, and according to the purity of my hands before his eyes.
verses.26: With the holy thou wilt be holy; and with the innocent man thou wilt be innocent.
verses.27: And with the excellent man thou wilt be excellent; and with the perverse thou wilt shew frowardness.
verses.28: For thou wilt save the lowly people, and wilt humble the eyes of the proud.
verses.29: For thou, O Lord, wilt light my lamp: my God, thou wilt lighten my darkness.
verses.30: For by thee shall I be delivered from a troop; and by my God I will pass over a wall.
verses.31: As for my God, his way is perfect: the oracles of the Lord are tried in the fire; he is a protector of all them that hope in him.
verses.32: For who is God but the Lord? and who is a God except our God?
verses.33: It is God that girds me with strength, and has made my way blameless:
verses.34: who strengthens my feet as hart's feet, and sets me upon high places.
verses.35: He instructs my hands for war; and thou hast made my arms as a brazen bow.
verses.36: And thou hast made me secure in my salvation: and thy right hand has helped me, and thy correction has upheld me to the end; yea, thy correction itself shall instruct me.
verses.37: Thou hast made room for my goings under me, and my footsteps did not fail.
verses.38: I will pursue mine enemies, and overtake them; and I will not turn back until they are consumed.
verses.39: I will dash them to pieces and they shall not be able to stand: they shall fall under my feet.
verses.40: For thou hast girded me with strength for war: thou hast beaten down under me all that rose up against me.
verses.41: And thou hast made mine enemies turn their backs before me; and thou hast destroyed them that hated me.
verses.42: They cried, but there was no deliverer: even to the Lord, but he hearkened not to them.
verses.43: I will grind them as the mud of the streets: and I will beat them small as dust before the wind.
verses.44: Deliver me from the gainsayings of the people: thou shalt make me head of the Gentiles: a people whom I knew not served me,
verses.45: at the hearing of the ear they obeyed me: the strange children lied to me.
verses.46: The strange children waxed old, and fell away from their paths through lameness.
verses.47: The Lord lives; and blessed be my God; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.
verses.48: It is God that avenges me, and has subdued the nations under me;
verses.49: my deliverer from angry enemies: thou shalt set me on high above them that rise up against me: thou shalt deliver me from the unrighteous man.
verses.50: Therefore will I confess to thee, O Lord, among the Gentiles, and sing to thy name.
verses.51: God magnifies the deliverances of his king; and deals mercifully with David his anointed, and his seed, for ever.

verses.1: The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
verses.2: Thou hast given him his heart’s desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.
verses.3: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.
verses.4: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.
verses.5: His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.
verses.6: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.
verses.7: For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.
verses.8: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.
verses.9: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.
verses.10: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
verses.11: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.
verses.12: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.
verses.13: Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.

verses.1: Εἰς τὸ τέλος, ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυίδ.
verses.2: Κύριε, ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου εὐφρανθήσεται ὁ βασιλεὺς, καὶ ἐπὶ τῷ σωτηρίῳ σου ἀγαλλιάσεται σφόδρα.
verses.3: Τὴν ἐπιθυμίαν τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ ἔδωκας αὐτῷ, καὶ τὴν δέησιν τῶν χειλέων αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐστέρησας αὐτόν· διάψαλμα.
verses.4: Ὅτι προέφθασας αὐτὸν ἐν εὐλογίαις χρηστότητος, ἔθηκας ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ στέφανον ἐκ λίθου τιμίου.
verses.5: Ζωὴν ᾐτήσατό σε, καὶ ἔδωκας αὐτῷ μακρότητα ἡμερῶν εἰς αἰῶνα αἰῶνος.
verses.6: Μεγάλη ἡ δόξα αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ σωτηρίῳ σου, δόξαν καὶ μεγαλοπρέπειαν ἐπιθήσεις ἐπʼ αὐτόν.
verses.7: Ὅτι δώσεις αὐτῷ εὐλογίαν εἰς αἰῶνα αἰῶνος, εὐφρανεῖς αὐτὸν ἐν χαρᾷ μετὰ τοῦ προσώπου σου.
verses.8: Ὅτι ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐλπίζει ἐπὶ Κύριον, καὶ ἐν τῷ ἐλέει τοῦ ὑψίστου οὐ μὴ σαλευθῇ.
verses.9: Εὑρεθείη ἡ χείρ σου πᾶσι τοῖς ἐχθροῖς σου, ἡ δεξιά σου εὕροι πάντας τοὺς μισοῦντάς σε.
verses.10: Θήσεις αὐτοὺς ὡς κλίβανον πυρὸς εἰς καιρὸν τοῦ προσώπου σου, Κύριος ἐν ὀργῇ αὐτοῦ συνταράξει αὐτοὺς, καὶ καταφάγεται αὐτοὺς πῦρ.
verses.11: Τὸν καρπὸν αὐτῶν ἀπὸ γῆς ἀπολεῖς, καὶ τὸ σπέρμα αὐτῶν ἀπὸ υἱῶν ἀνθρώπων.
verses.12: Ὅτι ἔκλιναν εἰς σὲ κακὰ, διελογίσαντο βουλὴν, ἣν οὐ μὴ δύνωνται στῆσαι.
verses.13: Ὅτι θήσεις αὐτοὺς νῶτον ἐν τοῖς περιλοίποις σου, ἑτοιμάσεις τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτῶν.
verses.14: Ὑψώθητι Κύριε ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου· ᾄσομεν καὶ ψαλοῦμεν τὰς δυναστείας σου.

verses.1: Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.
verses.2: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.
verses.3: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.
verses.4: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.
verses.5: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.
verses.6: Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.
verses.7: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness’ sake, O LORD.
verses.8: Good and upright is the LORD: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.
verses.9: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.
verses.10: All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verses.11: For thy name’s sake, O LORD, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.
verses.12: What man is he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.
verses.13: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.
verses.14: The secret of the LORD is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.
verses.15: Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.
verses.16: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.
verses.17: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.
verses.18: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.
verses.19: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.
verses.20: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.
verses.21: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.
verses.22: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.

verses.1: Ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυίδ. Πρὸς σὲ, Κύριε, ᾖρα τὴν ψυχήν μου.
verses.2: Ὁ Θεός μου ἐπὶ σοὶ πέποιθα, μὴ καταισχυνθείην· μηδὲ καταγελασάτωσάν μου οἱ ἐχθροί μου,
verses.3: καὶ γὰρ πάντες οἱ ὑπομένοντές σε οὐ μὴ καταισχυνθῶσιν· αἰσχυνθήτωσαν οἱ ἀνομοῦντες διακενῆς.
verses.4: Τὰς ὁδούς σου, Κύριε, γνώρισόν μοι, καὶ τὰς τρίβους σου δίδαξόν με.
verses.5: Ὁδήγησόν με ἐπὶ τὴν ἀλήθειάν σου, καὶ δίδαξόν με, ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ Θεὸς ὁ σωτήρ μου, καὶ σὲ ὑπέμεινα ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν.
verses.6: Μνήσθητι τῶν οἰκτιρμῶν σου Κύριε, καὶ τὰ ἐλέη σου, ὅτι ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος εἰσίν.
verses.7: Ἁμαρτίας νεότητός μου, καὶ ἀγνοίας μου μὴ μνησθῇς· κατὰ τὸ ἔλεός σου μνήσθητί μου, ἕνεκεν τῆς χρηστότητος σου, Κύριε.
verses.8: Χρηστὸς καὶ εὐθὴς ὁ Κύριος, διὰ τοῦτο νομοθετήσει ἁμαρτάνοντας ἐν ὁδῷ.
verses.9: Ὁδηγήσει πρᾳεῖς ἐν κρίσει, διδάξει πρᾳεῖς ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ.
verses.10: Πᾶσαι αἱ ὁδοὶ Κυρίου ἔλεος καὶ ἀλήθεια τοῖς ἐκζητοῦσι τὴν διαθήκην αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ μαρτύρια αὐτοῦ.
verses.11: Ἕνεκα τοῦ ὀνόματός σου, Κύριε, καὶ ἱλάσῃ τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ μου, πολλὴ γάρ ἐστι.
verses.12: Τίς ἐστιν ἄνθρωπος ὁ φοβούμενος τὸν Κύριον; νομοθετήσει αὐτῷ ἐν ὁδῷ, ᾗ ᾑρετίσατο.
verses.13: Ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ ἐν ἀγαθοῖς αὐλισθήσεται, καὶ τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ κληρονομήσει γῆν.
verses.14: Κραταίωμα Κύριος τῶν φοβουμένων αὐτὸν, καὶ ἡ διαθήκη αὐτοῦ τοῦ δηλῶσαι αὐτοῖς.
verses.15: Οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου διαπαντὸς πρὸς τὸν Κύριον, ὅτι αὐτὸς ἐκσπάσει ἐκ παγίδος τοὺς πόδας μου.
verses.16: Ἐπίβλεψον ἐπʼ ἐμὲ καὶ ἐλέησόν με, ὅτι μονογενὴς καὶ πτωχός εἰμι ἐγώ.
verses.17: Αἱ θλίψεις τῆς καρδίας μου ἐπληθύνθησαν, ἐκ τῶν ἀναγκῶν μου ἐξάγαγέ με·
verses.18: Ἴδε τὴν ταπείνωσίν μου καὶ τὸν κόπον μου, καὶ ἄφες πάσας τὰς ἁμαρτίας μου.
verses.19: Ἴδε τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου, ὅτι ἐπληθύνθησαν, καὶ μῖσος ἄδικον ἐμίσησάν με.
verses.20: Φύλαξον τὴν ψυχήν μου καὶ ῥῦσαί με· μὴ καταισχυνθείην, ὅτι ἤλπισα ἐπὶ σέ.
verses.21: Ἄκακοι καὶ εὐθεῖς ἐκολλῶντό μοι, ὅτι ὑπέμεινά σε, Κύριε.
verses.22: Λύτρωσαι ὁ Θεὸς τὸν Ἰσραὴλ ἐκ πασῶν τῶν θλίψεων αὐτοῦ.

verses.1: A Psalm of David. To thee, O Lord, have I lifted up my soul.
verses.2: O my God, I have trusted in thee: let me not be confounded, neither let mine enemies laugh me to scorn.
verses.3: For none of them that wait on thee shall in any wise be ashamed: let them be ashamed that transgress without cause.

verses.8: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD, will I seek.
verses.9: Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.
verses.10: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.
verses.11: Teach me thy way, O LORD, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.
verses.12: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.
verses.13: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
verses.14: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.

verses.1: A Psalm of David, before he was anointed. The Lord is my light and my Saviour; whom shall I fear? the Lord is the defender of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
verses.2: When evil-doers drew nigh against me to eat up my flesh, my persecutors and mine enemies, they fainted and fell.
verses.3: Though an army should set itself in array against me, my heart shall not be afraid: though war should rise up against me, in this am I confident.
verses.4: One thing have I asked of the Lord, this will I earnestly seek: that I should dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, that I should behold the fair beauty of the Lord, and survey his temple.
verses.5: For in the day of mine afflictions he hid me in his tabernacle: he sheltered me in the secret of his tabernacle; he set me up on a rock.
verses.6: And now, behold, he has lifted up mine head over mine enemies: I went round and offered in his tabernacle the sacrifice of joy; I will sing, even sing psalms to the Lord.
verses.7: Hear, O Lord, my voice which I have uttered aloud: pity me, and hearken to me.
verses.8: My heart said to thee, I have diligently sought thy face: thy face, O Lord, I will seek.
verses.9: Turn not thy face away from me, turn not thou away from thy servant in anger: be thou my helper, forsake me not; and, O God my Saviour, overlook me not.
verses.10: For my father and my mother have forsaken me, but the Lord has taken me to himself.
verses.11: Teach me, O Lord, in thy way, and guide me in a right path, because of mine enemies.
verses.12: Deliver me not over to the desire of them that afflict me; for unjust witnesses have risen up against me, and injustice has lied within herself.
verses.13: I believe that I shall see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.
verses.14: Wait on the Lord: be of good courage, and let thy heart be strengthened: yea, wait on the Lord.

verses.12: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.
verses.13: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.
verses.14: But I trusted in thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my God.
verses.15: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
verses.16: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies’ sake.
verses.17: Let me not be ashamed, O LORD; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.
verses.18: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.
verses.19: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!
verses.20: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
verses.21: Blessed be the LORD: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.
verses.22: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.
verses.23: O love the LORD, all ye his saints: for the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.
verses.24: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.

verses.1: Εἰς τὸ τέλος, ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυὶδ, ἐκστάσεως.
verses.2: Ἐπὶ σοὶ Κύριε ἤλπισα, μὴ καταισχυνθείην εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, ἐν τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ σου ῥῦσαί με καὶ ἐξελοῦ με.
verses.3: Κλῖνον πρὸς μὲ τὸ οὖς σου, τὰχυνον τοῦ ἐξελέσθαι με γενοῦ μοι εἰς Θεὸν ὑπερασπιστὴν καὶ εἰς οἶκον καταφυγῆς τοῦ σῶσαί με.
verses.4: Ὅτι κραταίωμά μου καὶ καταφυγή μου εἶ σὺ, καὶ ἕνεκεν τοῦ ὀνόματός σου ὁδηγήσεις με, καὶ διαθρέψεις με.
verses.5: Ἐξάξεις με ἐκ παγίδος ταύτης ἧς ἔκρυψάν μοι, ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ ὑπερασπιστής μου, Κύριε.
verses.6: Εἰς χεῖράς σου παραθήσομαι τὸ πνεῦμά μου, ἐλυτρώσω με Κύριε ὁ Θεὸς τῆς ἀληθέιας.
verses.7: Ἐμίσησας τοὺς διαφυλάσσοντας ματαιότητας διακενῆς· ἐγὼ δὲ ἐπὶ τῷ Κυρίῳ ἤλπισα.
verses.8: Ἀγαλλιάσομαι καὶ εὐφρανθήσομαι ἐπὶ τῷ ἐλέει σου· ὅτι ἐπεῖδες τὴν ταπείνωσίν μου, ἔσωσας ἐκ τῶν ἀναγκῶν τὴν ψυχήν μου.
verses.9: Καὶ οὐ συνέκλεισάς με εἰς χεῖρας ἐχθροῦ, ἔστησας ἐν εὐρυχώρῳ τοὺς πόδας μου.
verses.10: Ἐλέησόν με, Κύριε, ὅτι θλίβομαι· ἐταράχθη ἐν θυμῷ ὁ ὀφθαλμός μου, ἡ ψυχή μου, καὶ ἡ γαστήρ μου.
verses.11: Ὅτι ἐξέλιπεν ἐν ὀδύνῃ ἡ ζωή μου, καὶ τὰ ἔτη μου ἐν στεναγμοῖς· ἠσθένησεν ἐν πτωχείᾳ ἡ ἰσχύς μου, καὶ τὰ ὀστᾶ μου ἐταράχθησαν.
verses.12: Παρὰ πάντας τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου ἐγενήθην ὄνειδος, καὶ τοῖς γείτοσί μου σφόδρα, καὶ φόβος τοῖς γνωστοῖς μου· οἱ θεωροῦντές με ἔξω ἔφυγον ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ·
verses.13: Ἐπελήσθην ὡσεὶ νεκρὸς ἀπὸ καρδίας· ἐγενήθην ὡσεὶ σκεῦος ἀπολωλὸς,
verses.14: ὅτι ἤκουσα ψόγον πολλῶν παροικούντων κυκλόθεν· ἐν τῷ συναχθῆναι αὐτοὺς ἅμα ἐπʼ ἐμὲ, τοῦ λαβεῖν τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐβουλεύσαντο.
verses.15: Ἐγὼ δὲ ἐπὶ σοὶ ἤλπισα, Κύριε· εἶπα, σὺ εἶ ὁ Θεός μου,
verses.16: ἐν ταῖς χερσί σου οἱ κλῆροί μου· ῥῦσαί με ἐκ χειρὸς ἐχθρῶν μου, καὶ ἐκ τῶν καταδιωκόντων με.
verses.17: Ἐπίφανον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἐπὶ τὸν δοῦλόν σου, σῶσόν με ἐν τῷ ἐλέει σου.
verses.18: Κύριε, μὴ καταισχυνθείην, ὅτι ἐπεκαλεσάμην σε· αἰσχυνθείησαν οἱ ἀσεβεῖς, καὶ καταχθείησαν εἰς ᾅδου.
verses.19: Ἄλαλα γενηθήτω τὰ χείλη τὰ δόλια, τὰ λαλοῦντα κατὰ τοῦ δικαίου ἀνομίαν ἐν ὑπερηφανίᾳ καὶ ἐξουδενώσει.
verses.20: Ὡς πολὺ τὸ πλῆθος τῆς χρηστότητός σου, Κύριε, ἧς ἔκρυψας τοῖς φοβουμένοις σε; ἐξειργάσω τοῖς ἐλπίζουσιν ἐπὶ σὲ, ἐναντίον τῶν υἱῶν τῶν ἀνθρώπων.
verses.21: Κατακρύψεις αὐτοὺς ἐν ἀποκρύφῳ τοῦ προσώπου σου ἀπὸ ταραχῆς ἀνθρώπων, σκεπάσεις αὐτοὺς ἐν σκηνῇ ἀπὸ ἀντιλογίας γλωσσῶν.
verses.22: Εὐλογητὸς Κύριος, ὅτι ἐθαυμάστωσε τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ ἐν πόλει περιοχῆς.
verses.23: Ἐγὼ δὲ εἶπα ἐν τῇ ἐκστάσει μου, ἀπέῤῥιμμαι ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν σου· διὰ τοῦτο εἰσήκουσας, Κύριε, τῆς φωνῆς τῆς δεήσεώς μου ἐν τῷ κεκραγέναι με πρὸς σέ.
verses.24: Ἀγαπήσατε τὸν Κύριον πάντες οἱ ὅσιοι αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἀληθείας ἐκζητεῖ Κύριος, καὶ ἀνταποδίδωσι τοῖς περισσῶς ποιοῦσιν ὑπερηφανίαν.
verses.25: Ἀνδρίζεσθε, καὶ κραταιούσθω ἡ καρδία ὑμῶν, πάντες οἱ ἐλπίζοντες ἐπὶ Κύριον.

verses.1: For the end, a Psalm of David, an utterance of extreme fear.
verses.2: O Lord, I have hoped in thee; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness and rescue me.
verses.3: Incline thine ear to me; make haste to rescue me: be thou to me for a protecting God, and for a house of refuge to save me.
verses.4: For thou art my strength and my refuge; and thou shalt guide me for thy name's sake, and maintain me.
verses.5: Thou shalt bring me out of the snare which they have hidden for me; for thou, O Lord, art my defender.
verses.6: Into thine hands I will commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O Lord God of truth.
verses.7: Thou hast hated them that idly persist in vanities: but I have hoped in the Lord.
verses.8: I will exult and be glad in thy mercy: for thou hast looked upon mine affliction; thou hast saved my soul from distresses.
verses.9: And thou hast not shut me up into the hands of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a wide place.
verses.10: Pity me, O Lord, for I am afflicted: my eye is troubled with indignation, my soul and my belly.
verses.11: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with groanings: my strength has been weakened through poverty, and my bones are troubled.
verses.12: I became a reproach among all mine enemies, but exceedingly so to my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that saw me without fled from me.
verses.13: I have been forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am become as a broken vessel.
verses.14: For I heard the slander of many that dwelt round about: when they were gathered together against me, they took counsel to take my life.
verses.15: But I hoped in thee, O Lord: I said, Thou art my God.
verses.16: My lots are in thy hands: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies,
verses.17: and from them that persecute me. Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me in thy mercy.
verses.18: O Lord, let me not be ashamed, for I have called upon thee: let the ungodly be ashamed, and brought down to Hades.
verses.19: Let the deceitful lips become dumb, which speak iniquity against the righteous with pride and scorn.
verses.20: How abundant is the multitude of thy goodness, O Lord, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee! thou hast wrought it out for them that hope on thee, in the presence of the sons of men.
verses.21: Thou wilt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the vexation of man: thou wilt screen them in a tabernacle from the contradiction of tongues.
verses.22: Blessed be the Lord: for he has magnified his mercy in a fortified city.
verses.23: But I said in my extreme fear, I am cast out from the sight of thine eyes: therefore thou didst hearken, O Lord, to the voice of my supplication when I cried to thee.
verses.24: Love the Lord, all ye his saints: for the Lord seeks for truth, and renders a reward to them that deal very proudly.
verses.25: Be of good courage, and let your heart be strengthened, all ye that hope in the Lord.

verses.1: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
verses.2: Blessed is the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.
verses.3: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.
verses.4: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
verses.5: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
verses.6: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.
verses.7: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
verses.8: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.
verses.9: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.
verses.10: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the LORD, mercy shall compass him about.
verses.11: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.

verses.1: Συνέσεως τῷ Δαυίδ. Μακάριοι ὧν ἀφέθησαν αἱ ἀνομίαι, καὶ ὧν ἐπεκαλύφθησαν αἱ ἁμαρτίαι.
verses.2: Μακάριος ἀνὴρ ᾧ οὐ μὴ λογίσηται Κύριος ἁμαρτίαν, οὐδέ ἐστιν ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτοῦ δόλος.
verses.3: Ὅτι ἐσίγησα, ἐπαλαιώθη τὰ ὀστᾶ μου, ἀπὸ τοῦ κράζειν με ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν.
verses.4: Ὅτι ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτὸς ἐβαρύνθη ἐπʼ ἐμὲ ἡ χείρ σου, ἐστράφην εἰς ταλαιπωρίαν ἐν τῷ ἐμπαγῆναι ἄκανθαν· διάψαλμα.
verses.5: Τὴν ἁμαρτίαν μου ἐγνώρισα, καὶ τὴν ἀνομίαν μου οὐκ ἐκάλυψα· εἶπα, ἐξαγορεύσω κατʼ ἐμοῦ τὴν ἀνομίαν μου τῷ Κυρίῳ, καὶ σὺ ἀφῆκας τὴν ἀσέβειαν τῆς καρδίας μου· διάψαλμα.
verses.6: Ὑπὲρ ταύτης προσεύξεται πρὸς σὲ πᾶς ὅσιος ἐν καιρῷ εὐθέτῳ· πλὴν ἐν κατακλυσμῷ ὑδάτων πολλῶν πρὸς αὐτὸν οὐκ ἐγγιοῦσι.
verses.7: Σύ μου εἶ καταφυγὴ ἀπὸ θλίψεως τῆς περιεχούσης με, τὸ ἀγαλλίαμά μου λύτρωσαί με ἀπὸ τῶν κυκλωσάντων με· διάψαλμα.
verses.8: Συνετιῶ σε καὶ συμβιβῶ σε ἐν ὁδῷ ταύτῃ ᾗ πορεύσῃ, ἐπιστηριῶ ἐπὶ σὲ τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου.
verses.9: Μὴ γίνεσθε ὡς ἵππος καὶ ἡμίονος, οἷς οὐκ ἔστι σύνεσις· ἐν χαλινῷ καὶ κημῷ τὰς σιαγόνας αὐτῶν ἄγξαι τῶν μὴ ἐγγιζόντων πρὸς σέ.
verses.10: Πολλαὶ αἱ μάστιγες τοῦ ἁμαρτωλοῦ, τὸν δὲ ἐλπίζοντα ἐπὶ Κύριον ἔλεος κυκλώσει.
verses.11: Εὐφράνθητε ἐπὶ Κύριον καὶ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε δίκαιοι, καὶ καυχᾶσθε πάντες οἱ εὐθεῖς τῇ καρδίᾳ.

verses.1: A Psalm of instruction by David. Blessed are they whose transgressions are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.
verses.2: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin, and in whose mouth there is no guile.
verses.3: Because I kept silence, my bones waxed old, from my crying all the day.
verses.4: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: I became thoroughly miserable while a thorn was fastened in me. Pause.
verses.5: I acknowledged my sin, and hid not mine iniquity: I said, I will confess mine iniquity to the Lord against myself; and thou forgavest the ungodliness of my heart. Pause.
verses.6: Therefore shall every holy one pray to thee in a fit time: only in the deluge of many waters they shall not come nigh to him.
verses.7: Thou art my refuge from the affliction that encompasses me; my joy, to deliver me from them that have compassed me. Pause.
verses.8: I will instruct thee and guide thee in this way wherein thou shalt go: I will fix mine eyes upon thee.
verses.9: Be ye not as horse and mule, which have no understanding: but thou must constrain their jaws with bit and curb, lest they should come nigh to thee.
verses.10: Many are the scourges of the sinner: but him that hopes in the Lord mercy shall compass about.
verses.11: Be glad in the Lord, and exult, ye righteous: and glory, all ye that are upright in heart.

verses.1: Plead my cause, O LORD, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.
verses.2: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.
verses.3: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.
verses.4: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.
verses.5: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the LORD chase them.
verses.6: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the LORD persecute them.
verses.7: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.
verses.8: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.
verses.9: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD: it shall rejoice in his salvation.
verses.10: All my bones shall say, LORD, who is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?
verses.11: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.
verses.12: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.
verses.13: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.
verses.14: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.
verses.15: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:
verses.16: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.
verses.17: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.
verses.18: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.
verses.19: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
verses.20: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.
verses.21: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.
verses.22: This thou hast seen, O LORD: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.
verses.23: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.
verses.24: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.
verses.25: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.
verses.26: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.
verses.27: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the LORD be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.
verses.28: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.

verses.1: Τῷ Δαυίδ. Δικάσον, Κύριε, τοὺς ἀδικοῦντάς με, πολέμησον τοὺς πολεμοῦντάς με.
verses.2: Ἐπιλαβοῦ ὅπλου καὶ θυρεοῦ, καὶ ἀνάστηθι εἰς βοήθειάν μοι.
verses.3: Ἔκχεον ῥομφαίαν, καὶ σύγκλεισον ἐξεναντίας τῶν καταδιωκόντων με· εἰπὸν τῇ ψυχῇ μου, σωτηρία σου ἐγώ εἰμι.
verses.4: Αἰσχυνθείησαν καὶ ἐντραπείησαν οἱ ζητοῦντες τὴν ψυχήν μου, ἀποστραφείησαν εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω, καὶ καταισχυνθείησαν οἱ λογιζόμενοί μοι κακά.
verses.5: Γενηθήτωσαν ὡσεὶ χοῦς κατὰ πρόσωπον ἀνέμου, καὶ ἄγγελος Κυρίου ἐκθλίβων αὐτούς.
verses.6: Γενηθήτω ἡ ὁδὸς αὐτῶν σκότος καὶ ὀλίσθημα, καὶ ἄγγελος Κυρίου καταδιώκων αὐτούς.
verses.7: Ὅτι δωρεὰν ἔκρυψάν μοι διαφθορὰν παγίδος αὐτῶν, μάτην ὠνείδισαν τὴν ψυχήν μου.
verses.8: Ἐλθέτω αὐτοῖς παγὶς ἣν οὐ γινώσκουσι, καὶ ἡ θήρα ἣν ἔκρυψαν, συλλαβέτω αὐτοὺς, καὶ ἐν τῇ παγίδι πεσοῦνται ἐν αὐτῇ.
verses.9: Ἡ δὲ ψυχή μου ἀγαλλιάσεται ἐπὶ τῷ Κυρίῳ, τερφθήσεται ἐπὶ τῷ σωτηρίῳ αὐτοῦ.
verses.10: Πάντα τὰ ὀστᾶ μου ἐροῦσι, Κύριε τίς ὅμοιός σοι; ῥυόμενος πτωχὸν ἐκ χειρὸς στερεωτέρων αὐτοῦ, καὶ πτωχὸν καὶ πένητα ἀπὸ τῶν διαρπαζόντων αὐτόν.
verses.11: Ἀναστάντες μάρτυρες ἄδικοι, ἃ οὐκ ἐγίνωσκον, ἐπηρώτων με.
verses.12: Ἀνταπεδίδοσάν μοι πονηρὰ ἀντὶ καλῶν, καὶ ἀτεκνίαν τῇ ψυχῇ μου.
verses.13: Ἐγὼ δὲ ἐν τῷ αὐτοὺς παρενοχλεῖν μοι, ἐνεδυόμην σάκκον· καὶ ἐταπείνουν ἐν νηστείᾳ τὴν ψυχήν μου, καὶ ἡ προσευχή μου εἰς κόλπον μου ἀποστραφήσεται.
verses.14: Ὡς πλησίον ὡς ἀδελφὸν ἡμέτερον οὕτως εὐηρέστουν, ὡς πενθῶν καὶ σκυθρωπάξων οὕτως ἐταπεινούμην.
verses.15: Καὶ κατʼ ἐμοῦ εὐφράνθησαν, καὶ συνήχθησαν, συνήχθησαν ἐπʼ ἐμὲ μάστιγες καὶ οὐκ ἔγνων· διεσχίσθησαν καὶ οὐ κατενύγησαν.
verses.16: Ἐπείρασάν με, ἐξεμυκτήρισάν με μυκτηρισμὸν, ἔβρυξαν ἐπʼ ἐμὲ τοὺς ὀδόντας αὐτῶν.
verses.17: Κύριε πότε ἐπόψῃ; ἀποκατάστησον τὴν ψυχήν μου ἀπὸ τῆς κακουργίας αὐτῶν, ἀπὸ λεόντων τὴν μονογενῆ μου.
verses.18: Ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι καὶ ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ πολλῇ, ἐν λαῷ βαρεῖ αἰνέσω σε.
verses.19: Μὴ ἐπιχαρείησάν μοι οἱ ἐχθραίνοντές μοι ματαίως, οἱ μισοῦντές με δωρεὰν, καὶ διανεύοντες ὀφθαλμοῖς.
verses.20: Ὅτι ἐμοὶ μὲν εἰρηνικὰ ἐλάλουν, καὶ ἐπʼ ὀργῇ δόλους διελογίζοντο.
verses.21: Καὶ ἐπλάτυναν ἐπʼ ἐμὲ τὸ στόμα αὐτῶν, εἶπαν, εὖγε, εὖγε, εἶδον οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἡμῶν.
verses.22: Εἶδες Κύριε, μὴ παρασιωπήσῃς, Κύριε μὴ ἀποστῇς ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ.
verses.23: Ἐξεγέρθητι Κύριε, καὶ πρόσχες τῇ κρίσει μου, ὁ Θεός μου καὶ ὁ Κύριός μου εἰς τὴν δίκην μου.
verses.24: Κρῖνόν με Κύριε κατὰ τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου Κύριε ὁ Θεός μου, καὶ μὴ ἐπιχαρείησάν μοι.
verses.25: Μὴ εἴποισαν ἐν καρδίαις αὐτῶν, εὖγε, εὖγε τῇ ψυχῇ ἡμῶν· μηδὲ εἴποιεν, κατεπίομεν αὐτόν.
verses.26: Αἰσχυνθείησαν καὶ ἐντραπείησαν ἅμα οἱ ἐπιχαίροντες τοῖς κακοῖς μου· ἐνδυσάσθωσαν αἰσχύνην καὶ ἐντροπὴν οἱ μεγαλοῤῥημονοῦντες ἐπʼ ἐμέ.
verses.27: Ἀγαλλιάσαιντο καὶ εὐφρανθείησαν οἱ θέλοντες τὴν δικαιοσύνην μου, καὶ εἰπάτωσαν διαπαντὸς, μεγαλυνθείη ὁ Κύριος, οἱ θέλοντες τὴν εἰρήνην τοῦ δούλου αὐτοῦ.
verses.28: Καὶ ἡ γλῶσσά μου μελετήσει τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου, ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν τὸν ἔπαινόν σου.

verses.1: A Psalm of David. Judge thou, O Lord, them that injure me, fight against them that fight against me.
verses.2: Take hold of shield and buckler, and arise for my help.
verses.3: Bring forth a sword, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say to my soul, I am thy salvation.
verses.4: Let them that seek my soul be ashamed and confounded: let them that devise evils against me be turned back and put to shame.
verses.5: Let them be as dust before the wind, and an angel of the Lord afflicting them.
verses.6: Let their way be dark and slippery, and an angel of the Lord persecuting them.
verses.7: For without cause they have hid for me their destructive snare: without a cause they have reproached my soul.
verses.8: Let a snare which they know not come upon them: and the gin which they hid take them; and let them fall into the very same snare.
verses.9: But my soul shall exult in the Lord: it shall delight in his salvation.
verses.10: All my bones shall say, O Lord, who is like to thee? delivering the poor out of the hand of them that are stronger than he, yea, the poor and needy one from them that spoil him.
verses.11: Unjust witnesses arose, and asked me of things I knew not.
verses.12: They rewarded me evil for good, and bereavement to my soul.
verses.13: But I, when they troubled me, put on sackcloth, and humbled my soul with fasting: and my prayer shall return to my own bosom.
verses.14: I behaved agreeably towards them as if it had been our neighbour or brother: I humbled myself as one mourning and sad of countenance.
verses.15: Yet they rejoiced against me, and plagues were plentifully brought against me, and I knew it not: they were scattered, but repented not.
verses.16: They tempted me, they sneered at me most contemptuously, they gnashed their teeth upon me.
verses.17: O Lord, when wilt thou look upon me? Deliver my soul from their mischief, mine only-begotten one from the lions.
verses.18: I will give thanks to thee even in a great congregation: in an abundant people I will praise thee.
verses.19: Let not them that are mine enemies without a cause rejoice against me; who hate me for nothing, and wink with their eyes.
verses.20: For to me they spoke peaceably, but imagined deceits in their anger.
verses.21: And they opened wide their mouth upon me; they said, Aha, aha, our eyes have seen it.
verses.22: Thou hast seen it, O Lord: keep not silence: O Lord, withdraw not thyself from me.
verses.23: Awake, O Lord, and attend to my judgment, even to my cause, my God and my Lord.
verses.24: Judge me, O Lord, according to thy righteousness, O Lord my God; and let them not rejoice against me.
verses.25: Let them not say in their hearts, Aha, aha, it is pleasing to our soul: neither let them say, We have devoured him.
verses.26: Let them be confounded and ashamed together that rejoice at my afflictions: let them be clothed with shame and confusion that speak great swelling words against me.
verses.27: Let them that rejoice in my righteousness exult and be glad: and let them say continually, The Lord be magnified, who desire the peace of his servant.
verses.28: And my tongue shall meditate on thy righteousness, and on thy praise all the day.

verses.1: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.
verses.2: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
verses.3: Trust in the LORD, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
verses.4: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
verses.5: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
verses.6: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.
verses.7: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
verses.8: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
verses.9: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.
verses.10: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.
verses.11: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
verses.12: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.
verses.13: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.
verses.14: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.
verses.15: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
verses.16: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.
verses.17: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.
verses.18: The LORD knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.
verses.19: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
verses.20: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.
verses.21: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.
verses.22: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.
verses.23: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.
verses.24: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth him with his hand.
verses.25: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
verses.26: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.
verses.27: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.
verses.28: For the LORD loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.29: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.
verses.30: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.
verses.31: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.
verses.32: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.
verses.33: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
verses.34: Wait on the LORD, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.
verses.35: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.
verses.36: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
verses.37: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.
verses.38: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.39: But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD: he is their strength in the time of trouble.
verses.40: And the LORD shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.

verses.1: Τῷ Δαυίδ. Μὴ παραζήλου ἐν πονηρευομένοις, μηδὲ ζήλου τοὺς ποιοῦντας τὴν ἀνομίαν.
verses.2: Ὅτι ὡσεὶ χόρτος ταχὺ ἀποξηρανθήσονται, καὶ ὡσεὶ λάχανα χλόης ταχὺ ἀποπεσοῦνται.
verses.3: Ἔλπισον ἐπὶ Κύριον, καὶ ποίει χρηστότητα, καὶ κατασκήνου τὴν γῆν, καὶ ποιμανθήσῃ ἐπὶ τῷ πλούτῳ αὐτῆς.
verses.4: Κατατρύφησον τοῦ Κυρίου, καὶ δώσει σοι τὰ αἰτήματα τῆς καρδίας σου.
verses.5: Ἀποκάλυψον πρὸς Κύριον τὴν ὁδόν σου, καὶ ἔλπισον ἐπʼ αὐτὸν, καὶ αὐτὸς ποιήσει.
verses.6: Καὶ ἐξοίσει ὡς φῶς τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου, καὶ τὸ κρίμα σου ὡς μεσημβρίαν.
verses.7: Ὑποτάγηθι τῷ Κυρίῳ, καὶ ἱκέτευσον αὐτόν· μὴ παραζήλου ἐν τῷ κατευοδουμένῳ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ αὐτοῦ, ἐν ἀνθρώπῳ ποιοῦντι παρανομίας.
verses.8: Παῦσαι ἀπὸ ὀργῆς καὶ ἐνκατάλιπε θυμὸν, μὴ παραζήλου ὥστε πονηρεύεσθαι.
verses.9: Ὅτι οἱ πονηρευόμενοι ἐξολοθρευθήσονται, οἱ δὲ ὑπομένοντες τὸν Κύριον, αὐτοὶ κληρονομήσουσι τὴν γῆν.
verses.10: Καὶ ἔτι ὀλίγον καὶ οὐ μὴ ὑπάρξῃ ἁμαρτωλὸς, καὶ ζητήσεις τὸν τόπον αὐτοῦ, καὶ οὐ μὴ εὕρῃς.
verses.11: Οἱ δὲ πρᾳεῖς κληρονομήσουσι γῆν, καὶ κατατρυφήσουσιν ἐπὶ πλήθει εἰρήνης.
verses.12: Παρατηρήσεται ὁ ἁμαρτωλὸς τὸν δίκαιον, καὶ βρύξει ἐπʼ αὐτὸν τοὺς ὀδόντας αὐτοῦ.
verses.13: Ὁ δὲ Κύριος ἐκγελάσεται αὐτὸν, ὅτι προβλέτει ὅτι ἥξει ἡ ἡμέρα αὐτοῦ.
verses.14: Ῥομφαίαν ἐσπάσαντο οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἐνέτειναν τόξον αὐτῶν, τοῦ καταβαλεῖν πτωχὸν καὶ πένητα, τοῦ σφάξαι τοὺς εὐθεῖς τῇ καρδίᾳ.
verses.15: Ἡ ῥομφαία αὐτῶν εἰσέλθοι εἰς τὴν καρδίαν αὐτῶν, καὶ τὰ τόξα αὐτῶν συντριβείη.
verses.16: Κρεῖσσον ὀλίγον τῷ δικαίῳ ὑπὲρ πλοῦτον ἁμαρτωλῶν πολύν.
verses.17: Ὅτι βραχίονες ἁμαρτωλῶν συντριβήσονται, ὑποστηρίζει δὲ τοὺς δικαίους ὁ Κύριος.
verses.18: Γινώσκει Κύριος τὰς ὁδοὺς τῶν ἀμώμων, καὶ ἡ κληρονομία αὐτῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἔσται.
verses.19: Οὐ καταισχυνθήσονται ἐν καιρῷ πονηρῷ, καὶ ἐν ἡμέραις λιμοῦ χορτασθήσονται·
verses.20: Ὅτι οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἀπολοῦνται, οἱ δὲ ἐχθροὶ τοῦ Κυρίου ἅμα τῷ δοξασθῆναι αὐτοὺς καὶ ὑψωθῆναι, ἐκλείποντες ὡσεὶ καπνὸς ἐξέλιπον.
verses.21: Δανείζεται ὁ ἁμαρτωλὸς, καὶ οὐκ ἀποτίσει, ὁ δὲ δίκαιος οἰκτείρει καὶ διδοῖ.
verses.22: Ὅτι οἱ εὐλογοῦντες αὐτὸν κληρονομήσουσι γῆν, οἱ δὲ καταρώμενοι αὐτὸν ἐξολοθρευθήσονται.
verses.23: Παρὰ Κυρίου τὰ διαβήματα ἀνθρώπου κατευθύνεται, καὶ τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ θελήσει.
verses.24: Ὅταν πέσῃ οὐ καταῤῥαχθήσεται, ὅτι Κύριος ἀντιστηρίζει χεῖρα αὐτοῦ.
verses.25: Νεώτερος ἐγενόμην, καὶ γὰρ ἐγήρασα· καὶ οὐκ εἶδον δίκαιον ἐγκαταλελειμμένον, οὐδὲ τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ ζητοῦν ἄρτους.
verses.26: Ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ἐλεεῖ καὶ δανείζει, καὶ τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ εἰς εὐλογίαν ἔσται.
verses.27: Ἔκκλινον ἀπὸ κακοῦ, καὶ ποίησον ἀγαθὸν, καὶ κατασκήνου εἰς αἰῶνα αἰῶνος.
verses.28: Ὅτι Κύριος ἀγαπᾷ κρίσιν, καὶ οὐκ ἐγκαταλείψει τοὺς ὁσίους αὐτοῦ, εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα φυλαχθήσονται· ἄμωμοι ἐκδικηθήσονται, καὶ σπέρμα ἀσεβῶν ἐξολοθρευθήσεται.
verses.29: Δίκαιοι δὲ κληρονομήσουσι γῆν, καὶ κατασκηνώσουσιν εἰς αἰῶνα αἰῶνος ἐπʼ αὐτῆς.
verses.30: Στόμα δικαίου μελετήσει σοφίαν, καὶ ἡ γλῶσσα αὐτοῦ λαλήσει κρίσιν.
verses.31: Ὁ νόμος τοῦ Θεοῦ αὐτοῦ ἐν καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ, καὶ οὐχ ὑποσκελισθήσεται τὰ διαβήματα αὐτοῦ.
verses.32: Κατανοεῖ ὁ ἁμαρτωλὸς τὸν δίκαιον, καὶ ζητεῖ τοῦ θανατῶσαι αὐτόν.
verses.33: Ὁ δὲ Κύριος οὐ μὴ ἐγκαταλίπῃ αὐτὸν εἰς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ, οὐδὲ μὴ καταδικάσαι αὐτὸν, ὅταν κρίνηται αὐτῷ.
verses.34: Ὑπόμεινον τὸν Κύριον, καὶ φύλαξον τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ὑψώσει σε τοῦ κατακληρονομῆσαι τὴν γῆν· ἐν τῷ ἐξολοθρεύεσθαι ἁμαρτωλοὺς, ὄψει.
verses.35: Εἶδον τὸν ἀσεβῆ ὑπερυψούμενον, καὶ ἐπαιρόμενον ὡς τὰς κέδρους τοῦ Λιβάνου·
verses.36: Καὶ παρῆλθον, καὶ ἰδοὺ οὐκ ἦν, καὶ ἐζήτησα αὐτόν, καὶ οὐχ εὑρέθη ὁ τόπος αὐτοῦ.
verses.37: Φύλασσε ἀκακίαν καὶ ἴδε εὐθύτητα, ὅτι ἐστὶν ἐγκατάλειμμα ἀνθρώπῳ εἰρηνικῷ.
verses.38: Οἱ δὲ παράνομοι ἐξολοθρευθήσονται ἐπιτοαυτὸ, τὰ ἐγκαταλείμματα τῶν ἀσεβῶν ἐξολοθρευθήσονται·
verses.39: Σωτηρία δὲ τῶν δικαίων παρὰ Κυρίου, καὶ ὑπερασπιστὴς αὐτῶν ἐστιν ἐν καιρῷ θλίψεως.
verses.40: Καὶ βοηθήσει αὐτοῖς Κύριος, καὶ ῥύσεται αὐτοὺς, καὶ ἐξελεῖται αὐτοὺς ἐξ ἁμαρτωλῶν, καὶ σώσει αὐτοὺς; ὅτι ἤλπισαν ἐπʼ αὐτόν.

verses.1: A Psalm of David. Fret not thyself because of evil-doers, neither be envious of them that do iniquity.
verses.2: For they shall soon be withered as the grass, and shall soon fall away as the green herbs.
verses.3: Hope in the Lord, and do good; and dwell on the land, and thou shalt be fed with the wealth of it.
verses.4: Delight thyself in the Lord; and he shall grant thee the requests of thine heart.
verses.5: Disclose thy way to the Lord, and hope in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
verses.6: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noon-day.
verses.7: Submit thyself to the Lord, and supplicate him: fret not thyself because of him that prospers in his way, at the man that does unlawful deeds.
verses.8: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself so as to do evil.
verses.9: For evil-doers shall be destroyed: but they that wait on the Lord, they shall inherit the land.
verses.10: And yet a little while, and the sinner shall not be, and thou shalt seek for his place, and shalt not find it.
verses.11: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
verses.12: The sinner will watch for the righteous, and gnash his teeth upon him.
verses.13: But the Lord shall laugh at him: for he foresees that his day will come.
verses.14: Sinners have drawn their swords, they have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy one, and to slay the upright in heart.
verses.15: Let their sword enter into their own heart, and their bows be broken.
verses.16: A little is better to the righteous than abundant wealth of sinners.
verses.17: For the arms of sinners shall be broken; but the Lord supports the righteous.
verses.18: The Lord knows the ways of the perfect; and their inheritance shall be for ever.
verses.19: They shall not be ashamed in an evil time; and in days of famine they shall be satisfied.
verses.20: For the sinners shall perish; and the enemies of the Lord at the moment of their being honoured and exalted have utterly vanished like smoke.
verses.21: The sinner borrows, and will not pay again: but the righteous has compassion, and gives.
verses.22: For they that bless him shall inherit the earth; and they that curse him shall be utterly destroyed.
verses.23: The steps of a man are rightly ordered by the Lord: and he will take pleasure in his way.
verses.24: When he falls, he shall not be ruined: for the Lord supports his hand.
verses.25: I was once young, indeed I am now old; yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed seeking bread.
verses.26: He is merciful, and lends continually; and his seed shall be blessed.
verses.27: Turn aside from evil, and do good; and dwell for ever.
verses.28: For the Lord loves judgment, and will not forsake his saints; they shall be preserved for ever: the blameless shall be avenged, but the seed of the ungodly shall be utterly destroyed.
verses.29: But the righteous shall inherit the earth, and dwell upon it for ever.
verses.30: The mouth of the righteous will meditate wisdom, and his tongue will speak of judgment.
verses.31: The law of his God is in his heart; and his steps shall not slide.
verses.32: The sinner watches the righteous, and seeks to slay him.
verses.33: But the Lord will not leave him in his hands, nor by any means condemn him when he is judged.
verses.34: Wait on the Lord, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are destroyed, thou shalt see it.
verses.35: I saw the ungodly very highly exalting himself, and lifting himself up like the cedars of Libanus.
verses.36: Yet I passed by, and lo! he was not: and I sought him, but his place was not found.
verses.37: Maintain innocence, and behold uprightness: for there is a remnant to the peaceable man.
verses.38: But the transgressors shall be utterly destroyed together: the remnants of the ungodly shall be utterly destroyed.
verses.39: But the salvation of the righteous is of the Lord; and he is their defender in the time of affliction.
verses.40: And the Lord shall help them, and deliver them: and he shall rescue them from sinners, and save them, because they have hoped in him.

verses.1: O LORD, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
verses.2: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.
verses.3: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.
verses.4: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
verses.5: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.
verses.6: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.
verses.7: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.
verses.8: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
verses.9: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.
verses.10: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.
verses.11: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
verses.12: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.
verses.13: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.
verses.14: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.
verses.15: For in thee, O LORD, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.
verses.16: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.
verses.17: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.
verses.18: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
verses.19: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
verses.20: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.
verses.21: Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far from me.
verses.22: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.

verses.1: Φαλμὸς τῷ Δαυὶδ εἰς ἀνάμνησιν περὶ σαββάτου.
verses.2: Κύριε, μὴ τῷ θυμῷ σου ἐλέγξῃς με, μηδὲ τῇ ὀργῇ σου παιδεύσῃς με.
verses.3: Ὅτι τὰ βέλη σου ἐνεπάγησάν μοι, καὶ ἐπεστήριξας ἐπʼ ἐμὲ τὴν χεῖρά σου.
verses.4: Οὐκ ἔστιν ἴασις ἐν τῇ σαρκί μου ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς ὀργῆς σου, οὐκ ἔστιν εἰρήνη τοῖς ὀστέοις μου ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν μου.
verses.5: Ὅτι αἱ ἀνομίαι μου ὑπερῇραν τὴν κεφαλήν μου, ὡσεὶ φορτίον βαρὺ ἐβαρύνθησαν ἐπʼ ἐμέ.
verses.6: Προσώζεσαν καὶ ἐσάπησαν οἱ μώλωπές μου, ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς ἀφροσύνης μου.
verses.7: Ἐταλαιπώρησα καὶ κατεκάμφθην ἕως τέλους, ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν σκυθρωπάζων ἐπορευόμην.
verses.8: Ὅτι ἡ ψυχή μου ἐπλησθη ἐμπαιγμῶν, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἴασις ἐν τῇ σαρκί μου.
verses.9: Ἐκακώθην καὶ ἐταπεινώθην ἕως σφόδρα, ὠρυόμην ἀπὸ στεναγμοῦ τῆς καρδίας μου.
verses.10: Καὶ ἐναντίον σου πᾶσα ἡ ἐπιθυμία μου, καὶ ὁ στεναγμός μου οὐκ ἀπεκρύβη ἀπὸ σοῦ.
verses.11: Ἡ καρδία μου ἐταράχθη, ἐγκατέλιπέ με ἡ ἰσχύς μου, καὶ τὸ φῶς τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν μου οὐκ ἔστι μετʼ ἐμοῦ.
verses.12: Οἱ φίλοι μου καὶ οἱ πλησίον μου ἐξ ἐναντίας μου ἤγγισαν καὶ ἔστησαν, καὶ οἱ ἔγγιστά μου μακρόθεν ἔστησαν,
verses.13: καὶ ἐξεβιάζοντο οἱ ζητοῦντες τὴν ψυχήν μου· καὶ οἱ ζητοῦντες τὰ κακά μοι ἐλάλησαν ματαιότητας, καὶ δολιότητας ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ἐμελέτησαν.
verses.14: Ἐγὼ δὲ ὡσεὶ κωφὸς οὐκ ἤκουον, καὶ ὡσεὶ ἄλαλος οὐκ ἀνοίγων τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ·
verses.15: Καὶ ἐγενόμην ὡσεὶ ἄνθρωπος οὐκ ἀκούων, καὶ οὐκ ἔχων ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτοῦ ἐλεγμούς.
verses.16: Ὅτι ἐπὶ σοὶ Κύριε ἤλπισα, σὺ εἰσακούσῃ Κύριε ὁ Θεός μου.

verses.1: A Psalm of David for remembrance concerning the Sabbath-day.
verses.2: O Lord, rebuke me not in thy wrath, neither chasten me in thine anger.
verses.3: For thy weapons are fixed in me, and thou hast pressed thy hand heavily upon me.
verses.4: For there is no health in my flesh because of thine anger; there is no peace to my bones because of my sins.
verses.5: For my transgressions have gone over mine head: they have pressed heavily upon me like a weighty burden.
verses.6: My bruises have become noisome and corrupt, because of my foolishness.
verses.7: I have been wretched and bowed down continually: I went with a mourning countenance all the day.
verses.8: For my soul is filled with mockings; and there is no health in my flesh.
verses.9: I have been afflicted and brought down exceedingly: I have roared for the groaning of my heart.
verses.10: But all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hidden from thee.
verses.11: My heart is troubled, my strength has failed me; and the light of mine eyes is not with me.
verses.12: My friends and my neighbours drew near before me, and stood still; and my nearest of kin stood afar off.
verses.13: While they pressed hard upon me that sought my soul: and they that sought my hurt spoke vanities, and devised deceits all the day.
verses.14: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and was as a dumb man not opening his mouth.
verses.15: And I was as a man that hears not, and who has no reproofs in his mouth.
verses.16: For I hoped in thee, O Lord: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.
verses.17: For I said, Lest mine enemies rejoice against me: for when my feet were moved, they spoke boastingly against me.
verses.18: For I am ready for plagues, and my grief is continually before me.
verses.19: For I will declare mine iniquity, and be distressed for my sin.
verses.20: But mine enemies live, and are mightier than I: and they that hate me unjustly are multiplied.
verses.21: They that reward evil for good slandered me; because I followed righteousness.
verses.22: Forsake me not, O Lord my God: depart not from me.
verses.23: Draw nigh to my help, O Lord of my salvation.

verses.3: God looked down from heaven upon the sons of men, to see if there were any that understood, or sought after God.
verses.4: They have all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that does good, there is not even one.
verses.5: Will none of the workers of iniquity know, who devour my people as they would eat bread? they have not called upon God. There were they greatly afraid, where there was no fear:
verses.6: for God has scattered the bones of the men-pleasers; they were ashamed, for God despised them.
verses.7: Who will bring the salvation of Israel out of Sion? When the Lord turns the captivity of his people, Jacob shall exult, and Israel shall be glad.

verses.1: Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.
verses.2: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.

verses.6: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O LORD; for it is good.
verses.7: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.

verses.1: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
verses.2: To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.
verses.3: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.
verses.4: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.
verses.5: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:
verses.6: When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.
verses.7: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
verses.8: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.
verses.9: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
verses.10: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.
verses.11: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.

verses.1: A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Idumea.
verses.2: O God, my God, I cry to thee early; my soul has thirsted for thee: how often has my flesh longed after thee, in a barren and trackless and dry land!
verses.3: Thus have I appeared before thee in the sanctuary, that I might see thy power and thy glory.
verses.4: For thy mercy is better than life: my lips shall praise thee.
verses.5: Thus will I bless thee during my life: I will lift up my hands in thy name.
verses.6: Let my soul be filled as with marrow and fatness; and my joyful lips shall praise thy name.
verses.7: Forasmuch as I have remembered thee on my bed: in the early seasons I have meditated on thee.
verses.8: For thou hast been my helper, and in the shelter of thy wings will I rejoice.
verses.9: My soul has kept very close behind thee: thy right hand has upheld me.
verses.10: But they vainly sought after my soul; they shall go into the lowest parts of the earth.
verses.11: They shall be delivered up to the power of the sword; they shall be portions for foxes.
verses.12: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that swears by him shall be praised; for the mouth of them that speak unjust things has been stopped.

verses.1: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.
verses.2: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.
verses.3: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.
verses.4: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.
verses.5: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:
verses.6: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:
verses.7: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.
verses.8: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
verses.9: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.
verses.10: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.
verses.11: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
verses.12: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.
verses.13: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.

verses.1: For the end, a Psalm and Song of David.
verses.2: Praise becomes thee, O God, in Sion; and to thee shall the vow be performed.
verses.3: Hear my prayer; to thee all flesh shall come.
verses.4: The words of transgressors have overpowered us; but do thou pardon our sins.
verses.5: Blessed is he whom thou hast chosen and adopted; he shall dwell in thy courts; we shall be filled with the good things of thy house; thy temple is holy.
verses.6: Thou art wonderful in righteousness. Hearken to us, O God our Saviour; the hope of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are on the sea afar off:
verses.7: who dost establish the mountains in thy strength, being girded about with power;
verses.8: who troublest the depth of the sea, the sounds of its waves.
verses.9: The nations shall be troubled, and they that inhabit the ends of the earth shall be afraid of thy signs; thou wilt cause the outgoings of morning and evening to rejoice.
verses.10: Thou hast visited the earth, and saturated it; thou hast abundantly enriched it. The river of God is filled with water; thou hast prepared their food, for thus is the preparation of it.
verses.11: Saturate her furrows, multiply her fruits; the crop springing up shall rejoice in its drops.
verses.12: Thou wilt bless the crown of the year because of thy goodness; and thy plains shall be filled with fatness.
verses.13: The mountains of the wilderness shall be enriched; and the hills shall gird themselves with joy.
verses.14: The rams of the flock are clothed with wool, and the valleys shall abound in corn; they shall cry aloud, yea they shall sing hymns.

verses.1: Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:
verses.2: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.
verses.3: Say unto God, How terrible art thou in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.
verses.4: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.
verses.5: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.

verses.2: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.
verses.3: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.

verses.5: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.
verses.6: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.
verses.7: Hear me speedily, O LORD: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.
verses.8: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.
verses.9: Deliver me, O LORD, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.
verses.10: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
verses.11: Quicken me, O LORD, for thy name’s sake: for thy righteousness’ sake bring my soul out of trouble.
verses.12: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.

verses.1: So I returned, and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold the tears of such as were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.
verses.2: Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive.
verses.3: Yea, better is he than both they, which hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
verses.4: ¶ Again, I considered all travail, and every right work, that for this a man is envied of his neighbour. This is also vanity and vexation of spirit.
verses.5: The fool foldeth his hands together, and eateth his own flesh.
verses.6: Better is an handful with quietness, than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit.
verses.7: ¶ Then I returned, and I saw vanity under the sun.
verses.8: There is one alone, and there is not a second; yea, he hath neither child nor brother: yet is there no end of all his labour; neither is his eye satisfied with riches; neither saith he, For whom do I labour, and bereave my soul of good? This is also vanity, yea, it is a sore travail.
verses.9: ¶ Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.
verses.10: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.
verses.11: Again, if two lie together, then they have heat: but how can one be warm alone?
verses.12: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
verses.13: ¶ Better is a poor and a wise child than an old and foolish king, who will no more be admonished.
verses.14: For out of prison he cometh to reign; whereas also he that is born in his kingdom becometh poor.
verses.15: I considered all the living which walk under the sun, with the second child that shall stand up in his stead.
verses.16: There is no end of all the people, even of all that have been before them: they also that come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and vexation of spirit.
